title: Daitoride
overview:
From the arcade to the Saturn: a new "tile fortress" begins now.

This mahjong solitaire puzzle game challenges you to tear down fortresses built from stacked mahjong tiles. Pick out matching pairs of free tiles to clear them away and work through stage after stage of new layouts.

Choose the Standard mode to take on the stages, or go head to head with a friend in the VS mode.

- 1-2 players

アーケードからサターンへ
新たな“牌砦”が今始まる。
